Rake Street Ltd, a London-based commercial property rental company, with a registered address at Central Chambers, Dame Street, Dublin, was fined €1,500 after pleading guilty to failing to keep proper records for 2000, 2001 and 2002. Defence counsel said its only business was the rental of two commercial properties and it carried out 100 transactions a year.
